# MALDI-MSI data preparation 

## Software requirments 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(foreach)
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
```

```{r}
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/sce_MY_01.rds")

patient_meta <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_panel/data_analysis/data/Metadata_combined_RCC.csv",col_names = TRUE)

# Re-group subtypes 
sce$subtype_combined <- ifelse(sce$subtype %in% c("clear_cell_RCC", "papillary_RCC", "chromophobe_RCC"), sce$subtype, "other")
sce$subtype_combined[sce$subtype_combined == "clear_cell_RCC"] <- "ccRCC"
sce$subtype_combined[sce$subtype_combined == "papillary_RCC"] <- "pRCC"
sce$subtype_combined[sce$subtype_combined == "chromophobe_RCC"] <- "chrRCC"
## Update survival censoring
sce$status_OS <- ifelse(sce$censor_dead_0_alive_1 == 1, 0, 
       ifelse(sce$censor_dead_0_alive_1 == 0, 1, sce$censor_dead_0_alive_1))

sce$OS_months <- sce$survival_months

## Combine relevant disease progression categories and set colors
### Tumor stage
sce$pT_combined <- ifelse(sce$pT_simple %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", ifelse(sce$pT_simple %in% c("3","4"), "3/4", sce$pT_simple))
metadata(sce)$colors$pT_combined <- setNames(c("#ABCFE5", "#08306B"),c("1/2","3/4")) 

### ISUP grade 
sce$ISUP_combined <- ifelse(sce$ISUP %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", ifelse(sce$ISUP %in% c("3","4"), "3/4", sce$ISUP))
metadata(sce)$colors$ISUP_combined <- setNames(c("#FC9F81", "#67000D"),c("1/2","3/4")) 

sce$lymphocytes_combined <- ifelse(sce$lymphocytes %in% c("1","2"),"1/2", sce$lymphocytes)

### Necrosis 
metadata(sce)$colors$necrose <- setNames(c("#d8b2ff", "#3F007D"),c("0","1"))

### PDL1 score
metadata(sce)$colors$PDL1_score <- setNames(c("#AADBAB","#00441B"),c("0", "1"))
```

## Read in data 

### Match identifiers 

TO BE CONTINUED 
 
```{r}
# Raw data 
raw_data <- read_excel("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/data_analysis/MALDI_RCC_Data_LM.xlsx")

raw_out <- raw_data %>% pivot_longer(2:676, names_to = "ID", values_to = "intensity")

# Add Identifiers
raw_out$TMA <- ifelse(str_detect(raw_out$ID, "Z1"), "20", "224")
raw_out$spot_ID <- str_split(raw_out$ID, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,2]
raw_out$tissue_type <- str_split(raw_out$ID, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,3]
```

```{r}
TMA20_anno <- read_excel("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/data_analysis/ZTMA20punchfile_LM.xls")
TMA20_anno$PID <- str_replace(TMA20_anno$`SP Number`, " ", "")

TMA224_anno <- read_excel("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/data_analysis/ZTMA224punchfile_LM.xlsx")
TMA224_anno$PID <- str_replace(TMA224_anno$`SP Number`, "B", "B20")
```

```{r}

raw_20 <- raw_out %>% filter(TMA == "20") 

raw_20$PID <- TMA20_anno$PID[match(raw_20$spot_ID, TMA20_anno$`# spots`)]

## Add other relevant patient metadata based on sce object
meta_add <- colnames(patient_meta)[!colnames(patient_meta) %in% c("PID","grid","x","y","spot","no_tissue","sample_id")]

patient_meta <- as.data.frame(patient_meta)
              
for (entry in meta_add) {
  colData(sce)[,entry] <- patient_meta[,entry][match(colData(sce)[,"PID"],patient_meta[,"PID"])]
}


```


### Match annotations 

```{r}
peak_anno <- read_excel("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/metabolome/data_analysis/RCC_Annotated_Mass_LM.xlsx")

# For now just select the first ten columns 
peak_anno <- peak_anno[,1:10]

peak_anno$KEGG.pathway[peak_anno$KEGG.pathway == "NA"] <- NA
peak_anno$KEGG.map[peak_anno$KEGG.map == "NA"] <- NA
```

```{r}
peak_anno$name[match(raw_out$`m/z`, peak_anno$Mass)]

raw_out$Mass <- raw_out$`m/z`

# Merged based on mass
merged_df <- merge(peak_anno, raw_out, by = "Mass", all.x = TRUE)

merged_df <- merged_df %>% filter(intensity != 0)
```

#### Basic visualization 

```{r}
# Annotated peaks vs. not
summary(ifelse(is.na(match(raw_data$`m/z`, peak_anno$Mass)), FALSE, TRUE))

# Mass to metabolite matches 
n_matches <- merged_df %>% select(Mass, name) %>% unique() %>% group_by(Mass) %>% count() #n = 349 total annotated peaks
n_matches$m_z <- "m_z"

ggplot(n_matches, aes(x = m_z, y = n))+
  geom_jitter(position=position_jitter(w=0.1,h=0.1), color = "#E41A1C", size = 2)+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.color = NA)+
  theme_classic()+
  ylab("Metabolite matches per peak")

# Number of metabolites detected
n_met <- merged_df %>% group_by(ID) %>% count()
n_met$PID <- "PID"

ggplot(n_met, aes(x = PID, y = n))+
  geom_jitter(position=position_jitter(w=0.1,h=0.1),color = "#377EB8", size = 2)+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.color = NA)+
  theme_classic()+
  ylab("Number of metabolites per PID")

# Number of metabolites with pathway annotation
n_met_anno <- merged_df %>% filter(!is.na(KEGG.pathway)) %>% group_by(ID) %>% count()
n_met_anno$PID <- "PID"

ggplot(n_met_anno, aes(x = PID, y = n))+
  geom_jitter(position=position_jitter(w=0.1,h=0.1),color = "#377EB8", size = 2)+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.color = NA)+
  theme_classic()+
  ylab("Number of metabolites with pathway annotation per PID")

# Kind of pathway 
n_pathway <- merged_df %>% filter(!is.na(KEGG.pathway)) %>% group_by(KEGG.pathway) %>% count() %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% ungroup() %>% mutate(fra = n/sum(n)) %>% filter(n > 1000) %>% arrange(desc(n))

ggplot(n_pathway, aes(x = reorder(KEGG.pathway,-n), y = n))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", fill = "#984EA3")+
  theme_classic()+
  guides(fill = "none")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))+
  xlab("KEGG pathways")
```
